HEARING ON MIRRIAM YAMBAO ANICIETE'S PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME OF THE MINOR, NICOLE ANICIETE

Off Calendar Aug-06-2025 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: The matter came on for Change of name of Petitioners Mirriam Yambao and Nicole Aniciete.

Dept.505; Judge: Michelle Tong; Clerk: D. Carter; Matter not reported

Petitioners Mirriam Yambao Aniciete and Nicole Aniciete appeared in pro per, was placed under oath and testified.

Petition for change of name filed January 27, 2025.

Order to show cause filed January 27, 2025.

Notice of hearing filed April 8, 2025.

The Court addresses the petitioner.

The Petitioner provides testimony.

After reviewing the petition, hearing the testimony and there are no objections filed, The Court grants Petitioner Mirriam Yambao Aniciete request for change of name. Court deies Petitioner Nicole Aniciete request for change of name as she is a minor and turning 18 in two years.

Petitioner Mirriam Yambao Aniciete's Order Recognizing change of name and for issuance of new certificates was forwarded to the Civil Counter Supervisor for review and processing.
